abs_source_note: standard/ABS_v0.1.md was written in parallel with this catalogue and appeared before the final run; object names were checked against it and match (Participation Agreement, Mandate, Offer Snapshot, Purchase Record, Settlement Instruction, Delivery Record, Dispute Case, Decision Receipt, Trust Attestation). Reason codes AG0-AG5 and AG1-P/AG1-M match its A3/A4; ABS-* codes here are proposals this simulation adds. The brief's 'Offer Feed' is ABS v0.1's offer feed / Offer Specification (B2); 'allowance' here is its Allowance Policy (B3); the minimum evidence package is its Evidence Package (A5).
